title: Consecutive Project Overlaps
scenario: Identify if a project starts before the previous project (ordered by start_date) ends. Return 'project_id' and 'is_overlapping'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT)
hint: Use LAG() to compare the current start_date with the previous end_date.
correctQuery: SELECT project_id, CASE WHEN start_date < LAG(end_date) OVER(ORDER BY start_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overlapping FROM projects;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT); INSERT INTO projects VALUES (1, '2026-01-01', '2026-03-01', 1000), (2, '2026-02-01', '2026-04-01', 1000);
